## About
Hoss Roofing & General Contracting works out of Suite 200 on Central Expressway in McKinney. We're a general contractor, so the same team can handle your roof, siding, gutters, fences, paint and trim, and the kitchen or bathroom inside. You don't need a different company for each part of the job.
Our owner, Jestin Ross, would rather educate you than sell to you. We explain each step, document the work so there's always proof of what we did, and pull the required permits on every job. Our crew members have been with us since we started the company, so you know who is in your home.
We're a local DFW company, rated 5 from 174 Google reviews. Call us to set up an appointment and a free inspection.

## Services
- New roofing systems: New roof systems for homes around McKinney.
- Drone inspections: We fly a drone over your roof so you can see the damage yourself on a live screen.
- Exterior work: Brick, trim and paint on the outside of your home.
- Kitchen remodels, interior paint and flooring: Full kitchen remodels, interior painting and new floors.
- Fireplace work: One customer's cracked fireplace got a larger box, new stone and a new mantle.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer inspections?
A: Yes. Call us to schedule a free inspection of your property.

Q: Someone called me about storm damage and said they were Hoss Roofing. Was it you?
A: Probably not. We don't cold call or solicit storm damage work, and we only contact customers from our official number. If you're unsure, call us directly to check.

Q: Can I just stop by?
A: Our work is by appointment only. Give us a call and we'll set up a time to meet.

Q: Are you insured?
A: Yes. We are insured up to $2,000,000.00.
